proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ f μ x k hx hk
  classical
  let g : Module.End K V := f - μ • 1
  have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, (g ^ m) x = 0 := ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hmin : ∀ m < Nat.find hex, (g ^ m) x ≠ 0 := fun m hm => Nat.find_min hex hm
  have hspec : (g ^ Nat.find hex) x = 0 := Nat.find_spec hex
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.find hex) with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0] at hspec
    exact absurd hspec hx
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, Nat.find hex = n + 1 := ⟨Nat.find hex - 1, by omega⟩
    have hy : (g ^ n) x ≠ 0 := hmin n (by omega)
    have hker : g ((g ^ n) x) = 0 := by
      rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_succ', ← hn]
      exact hspec
    have hfy : f ((g ^ n) x) = μ • (g ^ n) x := by
      have : f ((g ^ n) x) - μ • (g ^ n) x = 0 := by simpa [g] using hker
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
    exact Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hfy, hy⟩
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (f : Module.End K V) (μ : K) (x : V) (k : ℕ), x ≠ 0 → ((f - μ • 1) ^ k) x = 0 → Module.End.HasEigenvalue f μ
